source_revision: Official Library Part Number Specification rev 2 (2024-05-08)

rules.regular_known: NNNN or NNNNN known LEGO part number
rules.variant: base plus alpha suffix; may indicate successive mould/version, runner mini-part, or compatibility legacy

semantics: Design IDs and Element IDs are distinct identifier classes.
Pattern codes are LDraw-local and must not be replaced with BrickLink/Rebrickable pattern IDs.
Assembly shortcuts represent combinations of physical parts and should not be counted as unique moulds.
Legacy library names may violate current conventions for backward compatibility.

pattern_theme_hints.c: control panels or superheroes; cXY also CMF numbered series
pattern_theme_hints.d: studios; dXY also unnumbered CMF series
